category_definitions.serialized/permanent: Identifiers embedded in versioned fixtures, wire schemas, on-disk data, or published artifact identities that must not be renamed by the brand migration.
category_definitions.compatibility: Legacy commands, environment names, repository identities, probes, and bridge contracts retained for existing users and integrations.
category_definitions.historical-attribution: Fork ancestry, authorship, third-party credit, release records, and benchmark evidence that must preserve their historical spelling.
category_definitions.migration-pending: Active source, tests, tooling, or current documentation whose internal legacy spelling remains to be handled by a later mechanical migration.
